# secret-producers.txt — EC-1 / ADR D4 of plan dev-public-env-config-completeness
#
# Maps each SECRET runtime var from runtime-env-manifest.txt to its PRODUCER:
# the step that materializes the VALUE into the cluster Secret the chart
# references by name. A SECRET runtime var with no row here (empty
# `materialized_by`) is treated as an orphan FAIL by
# TestRuntimeEnvCompleteness (per D4).
#
# Source of truth:
#   - .claude/knowledge-base/audits/2026-06-18-env-master-table.md (vars)
#   - infra/scripts/local/seed-post-cleanroom-all.sh (9-step chain)
#   - infra/helmfile/scripts/generate-secrets.sh (helm-time secret generation)
#   - dev-credentials.json (external operator-provided prereq for OAuth/Stripe)
#
# Format: VAR|producer-kind|producer-id
#   producer-kind ∈ { seed | helmfile | external-prereq | k8s-mount }
#   producer-id:
#     seed:           the seed script basename (e.g., seed-minio-canonical.sh)
#     helmfile:       the helmfile generator + chart (e.g., generate-secrets.sh→loop-runtime-api)
#     external-prereq: the file/operator action that must precede (e.g., ~/.loop-runtime/dev-credentials.json)
#     k8s-mount:      Kubernetes-provided (e.g., kubeconfig from in-cluster SA)
#
# A var appearing multiple times in the manifest (e.g., GITEA_TOKEN consumed by
# both loop-runtime-api AND loop-runtime-{app,...}-operator) lists ONE row here keyed by VAR.
# The Go guard checks (VAR appears in this file) — not per-(chart,VAR) tuples
# — since the producer materializes the value once into a Secret that multiple
# charts reference by name.

# === Seed-produced (via seed-post-cleanroom-all.sh canonical chain) ===
ARGOCD_TOKEN|seed|loop-runtime-ops seed argocd-gitea-creds
GITEA_TOKEN|seed|loop-runtime-ops seed gitea-token
GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY|seed|loop-runtime-ops seed github-app-dev
GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET|seed|loop-runtime-ops seed github-app-dev
MINIO_ACCESS_KEY|seed|loop-runtime-ops seed minio
MINIO_SECRET_KEY|seed|loop-runtime-ops seed minio
OPENBAO_VAULT_ROLE_ID|seed|loop-runtime-ops seed vault-role-id-sync
OPENBAO_VAULT_SECRET_ID|seed|vault-bootstrap-dev.sh
LOOP_RUNTIME_BROKER_TOKEN|seed|seed-broker-canonical.sh
LOOP_RUNTIME_BROKER_TOKENS|seed|seed-broker-canonical.sh

# === Helmfile-time (generate-secrets.sh + chart envFrom secretRef) ===
DATABASE_URL|helmfile|generate-secrets.sh→loop-runtime-db-credentials
LOOP_RUNTIME_API_DATABASE_URL|helmfile|generate-secrets.sh→loop-runtime-db-credentials
LOOP_RUNTIME_WORKER_DATABASE_URL|helmfile|generate-secrets.sh→loop-runtime-db-credentials
SESSION_TOKEN_SECRET|helmfile|generate-secrets.sh→loop-console-session
SESSION_TOKEN_SECRET_PREVIOUS|helmfile|generate-secrets.sh→loop-console-session
LOOP_RUNTIME_SERVICE_AUTH_SECRET|helmfile|generate-secrets.sh→loop-runtime-service-auth
LOOP_RUNTIME_SERVICE_AUTH_SECRET_PREVIOUS|helmfile|generate-secrets.sh→loop-runtime-service-auth
LOOP_RUNTIME_SERVICE_AUTH_ED25519_PRIVATE_KEY|helmfile|generate-secrets.sh→loop-runtime-service-auth-ed25519
LOOP_RUNTIME_EDGE_ROUTE_TOKEN|helmfile|generate-secrets.sh→loop-runtime-edge-route-token
LOOP_RUNTIME_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET|helmfile|generate-secrets.sh→loop-runtime-api-internal
LOOP_RUNTIME_ARGO_CALLBACK_SECRET|helmfile|generate-secrets.sh→loop-runtime-argo-callback-secret
LOOP_RUNTIME_SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY|helmfile|generate-secrets.sh→loop-runtime-secret-encryption-key

# === k8s-mount (kubeconfigs provided by ClusterCredential CR / SA token) ===
BUILD_KUBECONFIG|k8s-mount|ClusterCredential→loop-runtime-build-cluster-creds
CORE_KUBECONFIG|k8s-mount|in-cluster→loop-runtime-system/default
CELL_0_KUBECONFIG|k8s-mount|ClusterCredential→loop-runtime-cell-0-cluster-creds

# === External prereqs (operator-provided BEFORE task setup) ===
STRIPE_API_KEY|external-prereq|~/.loop-runtime/dev-credentials.json:stripe.api_key
STRIPE_SECRET_KEY|external-prereq|~/.loop-runtime/dev-credentials.json:stripe.api_key
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET|external-prereq|~/.loop-runtime/dev-credentials.json:stripe.webhook_secret
THEMORY_API_KEY|external-prereq|~/.loop-runtime/dev-credentials.json:themory.api_key
CF_API_TOKEN|external-prereq|$CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (operator env or .env)
DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN|external-prereq|$DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN (operator env, when-DO)
SPACES_ACCESS_KEY_ID|external-prereq|$SPACES_ACCESS_KEY_ID (operator env, when-spaces)
SPACES_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY|external-prereq|$SPACES_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY (operator env, when-spaces)
REGISTRY_DOCKER_CONFIG|external-prereq|operator-provided (when-registry)

# === Admin-path (req=Y(admin)) — operator-provided ===
LOOP_RUNTIME_ADMIN_API_KEY|external-prereq|operator-provided (admin path)
LOOP_RUNTIME_ADMIN_API_KEY_PREVIOUS|external-prereq|operator-provided (rotation window, admin)
LOOP_RUNTIME_ADMIN_SERVICE_AUTH_SECRET|external-prereq|operator-provided (admin path)
LOOP_RUNTIME_ADMIN_SERVICE_AUTH_SECRET_PREVIOUS|external-prereq|operator-provided (rotation window, admin)

# === Conditional (when-X) ===
